meta.source: Nathan 2026-10-14: feed the system every html we made, let them consume my older projects

project_ingest.law: Every HTML build Nathan ever made is system material. The indexer catalogs them all; the Archive ingests them under its rate-distortion budget; the agents consume them.
project_ingest.catalog: 449 HTML files inventoried at files/project-ingest-manifest.json — path, title, size. This is the ingestion queue.
project_ingest.indexing: The auto-indexer (import://indexer) walks the catalog over time: each project gets an element — title, era, what it taught the system. Duplicates and dead variants dedup by identity.
project_ingest.archive_budget: Full content ingestion obeys the Archive's 15 MiB rate-distortion ceiling: best-parts extraction keeps what matters (novel mechanics, visual DNA, language definitions), the rest stays as index entries pointing at the files. Rank by delta-D per delta-bits; discard what's already implied.
project_ingest.consumption: Agents query the project index through the element table: find a past build, see what it contributed, pull its best parts into new work. Old projects become training material for new genesis — the periphery learns from the past.
project_ingest.queue: Ingestion begins with the mandala build now running; the auto-index loop carries it over time with the world clock.
